notes: What 'time ago' is before a surface puts it into words (ADR-0104). `frontend/shared/format.ts` and `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/royaraqamia/app/shared/TimeAgo.kt` answer the same unit and count for the same instant; the web suite (`frontend/shared/__tests__/format-time-ago.test.ts`) and the app suite (`android/app/src/test/kotlin/com/royaraqamia/app/shared/TimeAgoTest.kt`) both assert these cases, so a threshold moved on one client alone fails exactly one of them. The words are not here: each surface renders its own generated copy.
